contractCoverage.obligation: Absent streaming keys resolve enabled across full Settings and lightweight daemon settings.
Malformed values use the default-on fallback while explicit durable false remains false.
No-settings producer fallback is default-on and uses durable config unless an env override applies.
Validation fallback projections use the intended default-on streaming shape without leaking Telegram live partials.
Editor loading state presents streaming as enabled until durable state loads.

adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The value falls back to true instead of string-coercing to an opt-out.
